name: 94107 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94107 (San Francisco) has 237 nonprofit organizations. 119 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 99 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (11% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94107 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94107 (San Francisco) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
